reviews.text: Very poor service

By far the worst restaurant I have been to. Firstly the waiter wasn’t able to take an order of only two items and was utterly confused about it . The cream of chicken which came after repeated follow ups was actually milk with sugar with a few bits of chicken thrown in . Worst was when the chef was actually defending it and finally admitted to it being made by someone else. The starter we ordered never came even after 45 mins of waiting so we just left as there not a single person around to even enquire about the status. Wish there was a negative rating that could actually be given !

A small but beautiful restaurant in Bengaluru near airport. It is part of Click hotel. Food is average service is good.

Very close to BLR airport.

The price for dinner buffet is ₹600 plus taxes per person. Inexpensive considering this place is close to the airport. We took buffet as it was fastest way to get food

The buffer spread esp for Non-vegetarians is limited. No NV starters. No juice.

The service is slow though the staff were courteous.

The restaurant is kinda small but the restaurant was not busy.

Overall a reasonable option near the toll plaza and Bengaluru airport
